verdict.rationale: Sentry documents OTLP ingestion, allowing OTel-instrumented traces/logs to be sent to Sentry, which supports the 'instrument once with open standards' goal, but its primary onboarding path pushes proprietary SDKs ('Drop in the SDK') rather than OTel-first instrumentation, and there's no evidence of easy backend switching or vendor-neutral export once using Sentry. missing for 10: documented guidance on switching backends away from Sentry using OTel, evidence of full feature parity (alerts/dashboards) when using pure OTel instrumentation instead of Sentry SDK, and independent confirmation of portability.
